label: Janet: attach to REPL kernel
command: janet -e '(import spork/netrepl) (defn project [d] (cond (or (os/stat (string d "/.git")) (os/stat (string d "/project.janet"))) d (if-let [i (last (string/find-all "/" d))] (if (> i 0) (project (string/slice d 0 i)))))) (def here (os/realpath ".")) (def root (string/triml (string/replace-all ":" "" (or (project here) here)) "/\\")) (def dir (string (or (os/getenv "USERPROFILE") (os/getenv "HOME")) "/.cache/janet-zed/repl/" root)) (defn read [name] (string/trim (slurp (string dir "/" name)))) (import spork/msg) (def token (read "token")) (defn hidden [s] (def q @"") (def recv (msg/make-recv s)) @{:write (fn [_ b] (:write s b)) :close (fn [_] (:close s)) :chunk (fn [_ n buf] (when (< (length q) n) (when-let [m (recv)] (def m (string/replace-all token "" m)) (buffer/push-word q (length m)) (buffer/push q m))) (when (>= (length q) n) (buffer/push buf (buffer/slice q 0 n)) (def r (buffer/slice q n)) (buffer/clear q) (buffer/push q r) buf))}) (netrepl/client "127.0.0.1" (read "port") (string token "term") (fn [h p] (hidden (net/connect h p))))'
